notes.title: SEED OF LIFE - UPDATE V. 1.0.13 AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Leonardo Interactive and Madlight Studio announce that the update v. 1.0.13 of Seed of Life is now available for download. This is the complete changelog:

[b]Overall game:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added inertia to jumps. 
[*]Fixed some physics issues where the player could climb walls when the sprint capsule was activated
[*]Updated cameras to fix some blending issues
[*]Added Walk mode entry in Settings. Cora will walk instead of run by default.
[*]Added tutorial explaining how to recharge the talisman
[*]Added tutorial explaining that the Lumium plants create a regeneration shield when full of Lumium.
[*]Added Lumium plants entry inside the Glossary
[/list]
[b]Area 2:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed one obsolete cutscene, now that plants have a tutorial explaining they can heal
[/list]
[b]Area 3:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed some invisible collisions
[*]Improved the climbing part leading to the falling stones challenge
[/list]     
Thanks as always for the support! See you soon for more news!

tags.feature: Added inertia to jumps.

tags.bug: Fixed some physics issues where the player could climb walls when the sprint capsule was activated
Updated cameras to fix some blending issues

tags.feature: Added Walk mode entry in Settings. Cora will walk instead of run by default.
Added tutorial explaining how to recharge the talisman
Added tutorial explaining that the Lumium plants create a regeneration shield when full of Lumium.
Added Lumium plants entry inside the Glossary

tags.bug: Removed one obsolete cutscene, now that plants have a tutorial explaining they can heal
Removed some invisible collisions

tags.balance_change: Improved the climbing part leading to the falling stones challenge

notes.title: SEED OF LIFE - UPDATE V. 1.0.11 AVAILABLE!

[list]

[*]Improved the crouch camera behavior

[*]Fixed an issue where Cora would pick the petals, having a wrong positioning

notes.title: SEED OF LIFE - UPDATE V. 1.0.4 AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Leonardo Interactive and Madlight Studios announce that the update v. 1.0.4 of Seed of Life is now available for download. This is the complete changelog:

     [b]Overall game:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved talisman compass arrows
[*] Updated controller keys mapping
[*] Removed forced walking from many cutscenes
[*] Picking petals interaction doesn’t interrupt capsules anymore
[*] Landmarks update: now they take 50 lumium and offer 10 life
[*] Fixed camera priorities to avoid strange movements in some cutscenes 
[*] Fixed cutscenes which might not have triggered if jumping
[*] Pedestals:
[list]
[*] Updated activation camera to appear behind Cora
[*] Updated interaction to be able to insert petals from anywhere around the -centerpiece
[*] Added some effects to emphasize that Cora is able to insert petals
[/list][/list]
[b]Area 1:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed invisible collision post Talisman collection
[/list]
[b]Area 2:[/b]
[list]
[*] Climbing zone at the beginning: updated path close to the falling bridge
[*] Removed platforms that would lead up to the light pedestal
[*] Tunnel leading to the Seed: removed the center platforms and added vision platforms -instead
[/list]     
[b]Area 3:[/b]
[list]
[*] Temple platforms: added visual effects and sounds for destruction and respawn
[*] Updated event MagnetsPathInfo to take into account the capsule
[*] Level design update
[list]
[*] After Manipulation Capsule Pedestal: removed Vision platforms and added 2 extra magnets
[*] Crossing pillars event: added some platforms at the beginning
[*] Free climb issue at the beginning of the area: player unable to climb down due to a collision intersection
[*] Free climb zone at the beginning
[*] Third shield: now the player is able to reach the petal from behind the shield
[/list][/list]
Thanks as always for the support. See you soon for more news.

tags.bug: [*] Fixed camera priorities to avoid strange movements in some cutscenes
[*] Fixed cutscenes which might not have triggered if jumping
[*] Removed invisible collision post Talisman collection
[*] Free climb issue at the beginning of the area: player unable to climb down due to a collision intersection
